verifiedArchitecturalLayout.value: Eight columns per short face, seventeen along each long face, with shared corners: forty-six distinct perimeter shafts.
Six further Doric columns on each end, twelve additional columns.
Two physically separate east and west cella chambers, no through-passage; the eastern chamber is larger.
Two-level U-shaped Doric colonnade; published interpretation describes nine shafts and a pier along each long side, three shafts between the two piers on the short return.

limits: No measured individual column inclinations, full entasis survey, curvature tolerances or site-control coordinates.
Published inner U layout has scholarly alternatives; schematic local column spacing and piers do not certify a recovered stone-by-stone arrangement.
The upper-tier member arrangement is modeled interpretively from the known two-tier form and is not established individually by the cited sources.
Materials: Realistic uses original synthesized stone color, normal-scale bump and roughness rather than licensed photographs, photogrammetry or sampled authentic surfaces.
Current and ancient building phases must not be conflated; this model represents a simplified classical-era architectural volume.
decision: Accepted as a more closely source-aligned schematic layout and material teaching study. Do not classify as an exact or survey-validated reconstruction.
